trs.20: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen<sup foot_note=197608>1</sup>
trs.85: A man [mockingly] demanded the punishment.
trs.22: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall-
trs.203: A questioner asked concerning a torment about to befall

trs.20: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
trs.85: It will fall on the disbelievers––none can deflect it––
trs.22: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off,-
trs.203: Upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,

trs.20: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.
trs.85: from God, the Lord of the Ways of Ascent,
trs.22: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
trs.203: From Allâh, the Lord of the ways of ascent.

verses.text_uthmani: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ

trs.20: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
trs.85: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him, on a Day whose length is fifty thousand years.
trs.22: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years:
trs.203: The angels and the Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] ascend to Him in a Day the measure whereof is fifty thousand years.

trs.20: So be patient with gracious patience.
trs.85: So be patient, [Prophet], as befits you.
trs.22: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).
trs.203: So be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), with a good patience.

trs.20: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
trs.85: The disbelievers think it is distant,
trs.22: They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event):
trs.203: Verily, they see it (the torment) afar off.

trs.20: But We see it [as] near.
trs.85: but We know it to be close.
trs.22: But We see it (quite) near.
trs.203: But We see it (quite) near.

trs.20: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,<sup foot_note=197609>1</sup>
trs.85: On a Day when the heavens will be like molten brass
trs.22: The Day that the sky will be like molten brass,
trs.203: The Day that the sky will be like the boiling filth of oil, (or molten copper or silver or lead).

trs.20: And the mountains will be like wool,<sup foot_note=197610>1</sup>
trs.85: and the mountains like tufts of wool,
trs.22: And the mountains will be like wool,
trs.203: And the mountains will be like flakes of wool.

trs.20: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
trs.85: when no friend will ask about his friend,
trs.22: And no friend will ask after a friend,
trs.203: And no friend will ask a friend (about his condition),

verses.text_uthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ

trs.20: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children.
trs.85: even when they are within sight of one another. The guilty person will wish he could save himself from the suffering of that Day by sacrificing his sons,
trs.22: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children,
trs.203: Though they shall be made to see one another [(i.e. on the Day of Resurrection), there will be none but see his father, children and relatives, but he will neither speak to them nor will ask them for any help]. The Mujrim, (criminal, sinner, disbeliever) would desire to ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by his children,

translation.text: They will be made to see each other

trs.20: And his wife and his brother
trs.85: his spouse, his brother,
trs.22: His wife and his brother,
trs.203: And his wife and his brother,

trs.20: And his nearest kindred who shelter him.
trs.85: the kinsfolk who gave him shelter,
trs.22: His kindred who sheltered him,
trs.203: And his kindred who sheltered him,

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ

trs.20: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
trs.85: and everyone on earth, if it could save him.
trs.22: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him:
trs.203: And all that are in the earth, so that it might save him.<sup foot_note=155002>1</sup>

trs.20: No!<sup foot_note=197611>1</sup> Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
trs.85: But no! There is a raging flame
trs.22: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-
trs.203: By no means! Verily, it will be the Fire of Hell,

trs.20: A remover of exteriors.<sup foot_note=197612>1</sup>
trs.85: that strips away the skin,
trs.22: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-
trs.203: Taking away (burning completely) the head skin!

translation.text: of the skin of the head

trs.20: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
trs.85: and it will claim everyone who rejects the truth, turns away,
trs.22: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).
trs.203: Calling<sup foot_note=155003>1</sup> (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from Faith) [picking and swallowing them up from that great gathering of mankind on the Day of Resurrection just as a bird picks up a food-grain from the earth with its beak and swallows it up] (Tafsir Al-Qurtubî)

trs.20: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
trs.85: amasses wealth and hoards it.
trs.22: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)!
trs.203: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from spending it in the Cause of Allâh).

trs.20: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
trs.85: Man was truly created anxious:
trs.22: Truly man was created very impatient;-
trs.203: Verily, man (disbeliever) was created very impatient;

trs.20: When evil touches him, impatient,
trs.85: he is fretful when misfortune touches him,
trs.22: Fretful when evil touches him;
trs.203: Irritable (discontented) when evil touches him;

trs.20: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
trs.85: but tight-fisted when good fortune comes his way.
trs.22: And niggardly when good reaches him;-
trs.203: And niggardly when good touches him.

trs.20: Except the observers of prayer -
trs.85: Not so those who pray
trs.22: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-
trs.203: Except those who are devoted to Salât (prayers).<sup foot_note=155004>1</sup>

trs.20: Those who are constant in their prayer
trs.85: and are constant in their prayers;
trs.22: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;
trs.203: Those who remain constant in their Salât (prayers);

trs.20: And those within whose wealth is a known right<sup foot_note=197613>1</sup>
trs.85: who give a due share of their wealth
trs.22: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.
trs.203: And those in whose wealth there is a recognised right

trs.20: For the petitioner and the deprived -
trs.85: to beggars and the deprived;
trs.22: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);
trs.203: For the beggar who asks, and for the unlucky who has lost his property and wealth, (and his means of living has been straitened).

trs.20: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
trs.85: who believe in the Day of Judgement
trs.22: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;
trs.203: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

trs.20: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
trs.85: and fear the punishment of their Lord––
trs.22: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-
trs.203: And those who fear the torment of their Lord.

trs.20: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
trs.85: none may feel wholly secure from it––
trs.22: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-
trs.203: Verily, the torment of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure. -

trs.20: And those who guard their private parts
trs.85: who guard their chastity
trs.22: And those who guard their chastity,
trs.203: And those who guard their chastity (i.e. private parts from illegal sexual acts).<sup foot_note=155005>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

trs.20: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,<sup foot_note=197614>1</sup> for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
trs.85: from all but their spouses or their slave-girls––there is no blame attached to [relations with] these,
trs.22: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,
trs.203: Except from their wives or the (women slaves) whom their right hands possess - for (then) they are not blameworthy.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ

trs.20: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
trs.85: but those whose desires exceed this limit are truly transgressors––
trs.22: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-
trs.203: But whosoever seeks beyond that, then it is those who are trespassers.<sup foot_note=155006>1</sup>

trs.20: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive.
trs.85: who are faithful to their trusts and their pledges;
trs.22: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;
trs.203: And those who keep their trusts and covenants.

trs.20: And those who are in their testimonies upright
trs.85: who give honest testimony
trs.22: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;
trs.203: And those who stand firm in their testimonies.

trs.20: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
trs.85: and are steadfast in their prayers.
trs.22: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-
trs.203: And those who guard their Salât (prayers) well.<sup foot_note=155007>1</sup>

trs.20: They will be in gardens,<sup foot_note=197615>1</sup> honored.
trs.85: They will be honoured in Gardens of bliss.
trs.22: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).
trs.203: Such shall dwell in the Gardens (i.e. Paradise), honoured.

trs.20: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],
trs.85: What is wrong with the disbelievers? Why do they rush to peer at you [Prophet],
trs.22: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-
trs.203: So what is the matter with those who disbelieve that they hasten to listen from you [O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), in order to belie you and to mock at you, and at Allâh’s Book (this Qur’ân)].

trs.20: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?<sup foot_note=197616>1</sup>
trs.85: from right and left, in crowds?
trs.22: From the right and from the left, in crowds?
trs.203: (Sitting) in groups on the right and on the left (of you, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)?

verses.text_uthmani: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ

trs.20: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
trs.85: Does every one of them expect to enter a Garden of bliss?
trs.22: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?
trs.203: Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of Delight?

trs.20: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.<sup foot_note=197617>1</sup>
trs.85: No! We created them from the substance they know,
trs.22: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!
trs.203: No, that is not like that! Verily, We have created them out of that which they know!

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ

trs.20: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings<sup foot_note=197618>1</sup> that indeed We are able
trs.85: and, by the Lord of every sunrise and sunset, We have the power
trs.22: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-
trs.203: So I swear by the Lord of all the [three hundred and sixty-five (365)] points of sunrise and sunset in the east and the west that surely We are Able

verses.text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

trs.20: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
trs.85: to substitute for them others better than they are- nothing can prevent Us from doing this.
trs.22: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).
trs.203: To replace them by (others) better than them; and We are not to be outrun.

verses.text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

trs.20: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
trs.85: So leave them to wallow in idle talk, until they come face to face with their promised Day,
trs.22: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-
trs.203: So leave them to plunge in vain talk<sup foot_note=155008>1</sup> and play about, until they meet their Day which they are promised -

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ

trs.20: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.<sup foot_note=197619>1</sup>
trs.85: the Day they will rush out of their graves as if rallying to a flag,
trs.22: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-
trs.203: The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly as racing to a goal,

verses.text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

trs.20: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
trs.85: eyes downcast and covered in shame: that is the Day of which they were warned.
trs.22: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!
trs.203: With their eyes lowered in fear and humility, ignominy covering them (all over)! That is the Day which they were promised!
